visual: Silver-white variegated leaves flushed pink · fragrant pale flowers for months
water: Regular at first · fairly drought tolerant after
soilWarning: Wet ground and cold exposure set it back
prune: Light trim after flowering · harder renovation every 3-4 years
hardinessNote: Hardy in most UK locations, approximately -15 to -10°C, but benefits from shelter in colder areas.
resilience: Drought resistant once established but less suited to cold exposed sites
uses: Sunny borders · patio pots · courtyard gardens · low hedging
uncertain: RHS currently lists the cultivar name status as unresolved and gives Linnaea × grandiflora 'Sparkling Silver' as a synonym.
peak: supplied research said "Summer to autumn"; converted to Jul-Oct so the app can parse it. Not from a source that stated months.
latin: cultivar moved from cvs into latin to match the deck's convention.
